result.summary: Found 1 major visual rendering issue where unintended UI icons are overlaid on a restaurant's food dish image, creating a broken visual appearance.

issues.description: The food dish image for 'Green Bowl Poké' has misplaced UI icons (a social media icon and location pin icon) overlaid on top of the dish, resulting in a broken, unintended visual layout of the restaurant card image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the incorrectly overlaid UI icons from the restaurant's food dish image to ensure only the intended food content is displayed, fixing the visual rendering error.
